# ETIS Framework

## Engineering Trustworthy Intelligent Systems (ETIS)

**Software Engineering, Governance, and Operational Trust in the AI Era**

Engineering Trustworthy Intelligent Systems (ETIS) is a repository-centered engineering framework and professional ecosystem for building, governing, operating, and stewarding trustworthy intelligent systems in the AI era.

ETIS integrates software engineering discipline, repository-centered evidence, operational trust, governance-by-design, human oversight, and responsible AI practices into a unified engineering approach.

## Vision

ETIS is more than a publication.

It is a professional engineering discipline and ecosystem that integrates software engineering, AI governance, operational trust, human oversight, evidence, and organizational stewardship across the full lifecycle of intelligent systems.

The objective is not simply to build systems that work.

The objective is to build systems whose claims can be examined, whose decisions can be governed, whose operation can be observed, and whose trustworthiness can be defended and improved over time.

---

## Core Principles

- **AI proposes; engineers verify.**
- **Governance is architecture.**
- **Context is control.**
- **Everything important leaves evidence.**
- **The model is not the system.**
- **A demo is not operational proof.**

---

## ETIS Ecosystem

ETIS is organized as a connected professional engineering ecosystem:

- 📘 **ETIS Framework Reference Work** — *Engineering Trustworthy Intelligent Systems*, the comprehensive full-lifecycle treatment of ETIS.
- 📚 **ETIS Two-Volume Professional Edition** — the integrated Framework Reference Work presented in two complementary volumes.
- 📗 **ETIS Professional Computing Series** — long-form works that develop durable professional computing capabilities aligned with ETIS. The inaugural title is *From Data Structures to Engineering Judgment: Professional Computing in the AI Era*.
- 📝 **ETIS Publications Program** — focused, citable White Papers, Executive Briefs, and Education Papers.
- 🎓 **ETIS Educational Ecosystem** — instructor resources, student resources, educational products, flagship implementation guidance, and institutional adoption materials.
- 🧭 **ETIS Engineering Platform** — the practical implementation environment for applying ETIS through Engineering Stages ES-100 through ES-114, templates, examples, governance assets, evidence, and project workspaces.
- 🛠️ **ETIS Engineering Platform Starter Kit** — the reusable repository implementation of the Engineering Platform.
- 💻 **ETIS Repository Ecosystem** — authoritative source, reusable engineering assets, and repository-centered evidence supporting the framework and its implementation.

The Framework defines the discipline.
The Framework Reference Work provides its comprehensive treatment.
The Professional Computing Series develops enduring professional capabilities.
Publications provide focused, citable guidance.
The Engineering Platform applies ETIS.
Repositories preserve source, reusable assets, and engineering evidence.

- Evidence-Centered Engineering
- Engineering Judgment
- AI Governance
- Agentic Systems and Human-Agent Teams
- Context Engineering
- Human Oversight
- Operational Trust
- Release and Operational Readiness
- System Stewardship

---

## Guiding Philosophy

ETIS is not simply about building intelligent systems.

It is about engineering intelligent systems that remain understandable, reviewable, governable, observable, operable, recoverable, improvable, and worthy of trust over time.
